newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates soft on lower domestic rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates soft on lower domestic rates.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were lower at the short end of the curve, while the six-month and one-year maturities remained unchanged, traders said on Friday.
Dealers said the drop in money market rates helped lower swap rates in the PHIBOR market for short-term maturities up to three months.
The six-month and one-year rates were usually less vulnerable to daily changes in money market rates, they said.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks are willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
